description: Source code for target-dependent utility functions in the zlib compression library, including memory operations and platform-specific memory allocation routines.

methods.name: zmemcpy
methods.description: Copies memory from source to destination, optimized for unrolling.

methods.name: zmemcmp
methods.description: Compares two memory blocks, returns comparison result.

methods.name: zcalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with platform-specific routines, with multiple implementations based on platform.

methods.name: zcfree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by zcalloc, with platform-specific routines.
